name: state-ref
description: resolveWithTrace over a page-state ref and an app-state ref (in a list, so the order is fixed). Each ref records one `state` step: `in` is the key, `out` the value as Dart's '$x' text. Format of every file in this folder: `state` {page, app} is merged app first, page over it; `event` (optional) is the trigger's event data; `value` is the raw wire value; `expected.value` is the resolved value and `expected.trace` the steps, each {op, in (only when the input is not null), out}.
